title.en: OpenAI rolls out Images 2.6 and two API image models
title.zhHans: OpenAI 推出 Images 2.6 与两款 API 图像模型

searchSummary.en: OpenAI said Images 2.6 reached ChatGPT and Codex on November 4, with Flare and Sunburst also available through its API.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 称 Images 2.6 于 11 月 4 日进入 ChatGPT 和 Codex，Flare 与 Sunburst 同时可通过 API 使用。

summary.en: OpenAI’s dated public account says Images 2.6 was available on November 4 across ChatGPT and Codex tiers on web, desktop and mobile, and GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst were available via API. Its posts described prompt- or image-to-GIF generation and reusable reference images. The full OpenAI article returned HTTP 403 in direct capture; detailed model performance or independent uptake are not inferred from the accessible posts or secondary summaries.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 在带日期的公开账号中称，Images 2.6 于 11 月 4 日面向各订阅层级的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 网页、桌面及移动端提供使用，GPT-Image-2.6 Flare 和 Sunburst 同时开放 API。帖子还介绍了由提示词或图片生成 GIF，以及重复使用已保存参考图的功能。直接获取 OpenAI 完整文章返回 HTTP 403；不能凭可读帖子及二手摘要推断具体性能或外部采用。

narrative.en: The X page was read directly as OpenAI’s own statement, not as independent X search coverage. The announcement supplies a launch claim; no first-hand external trial or independent performance result is included.
narrative.zhHans: 直接读取的是 OpenAI 自己在 X 的声明，不等于已完成 X 站内检索。公告支持发布阶段的表述；本轮没有外部亲自试用或独立性能结果。

text.en: OpenAI said Images 2.6 was available November 4 in ChatGPT and Codex and that Flare and Sunburst were available through the API.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 称 Images 2.6 于 11 月 4 日在 ChatGPT 与 Codex 可用，Flare 与 Sunburst 也已开放 API。

text.en: OpenAI’s accessible posts describe GIF generation and reusable reference images; neither feature performance nor broad user uptake was independently verified here.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 可读帖子介绍了 GIF 生成及参考图复用；本轮未独立验证功能效果或大规模采用。
